review_kind: AI-assisted semantic audit; not a human agronomy, logistics, market, accounting, or ML-expert review
method: Decomposed all seven final messages into atomic assertions.
Compared claims with all frozen policy metrics and affected delivery lines, not only selected references.
Used one authenticated GET of the persisted scenario to inspect batch-to-order allocation details; no credential was printed or retained.
Kept semantic findings separate from application validation.

summary.material_contradiction: Profit says Lean margin gains, but Lean margin delta is -52.87 SGD and Chair correctly says every policy margin falls.
summary.application_unsupported: Supply is semantically supportable within stated limits but remains unsupported because prose authored the quantity “zero”.
summary.v10_abstention_fix: Weather and Market are now clean, fact-free, references_verified abstentions.
summary.planning_trial: The separate V10 mission is REVIEW_WITHHELD with Council blocked, zero claims and zero inference audits because only 7 shared daily calls remained but 9 had to be reserved. It is negative budget evidence, not a live test of the new mission Supply guard.

cases.statement: Booked demand is identical across policies, yet scenario booked deliveries fall in every policy versus baseline, so the delay leaves booked orders short. Limit: these are synthetic policy comparisons, not observed outcomes.

assertions.text: Booked requested demand is identical across policies.
assertions.evidence: Baseline and scenario booked requested quantity is 824 kg for Lean, Balanced and Resilient; every requested delta is zero.

assertions.text: Scenario booked delivery falls for every policy.
assertions.evidence: Booked-delivery deltas are Lean -22 kg, Balanced -20 kg and Resilient -22 kg.

assertions.text: The delay leaves booked orders short.
assertions.evidence: The delayed batch moves from 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-17, and the 2026-09-14 booked line falls from 22 kg delivered to zero in every policy. Because yield also changes and the allocator reruns, the delay alone does not explain every aggregate delivery delta.

assertions.text: The comparison is synthetic rather than observed.
assertions.evidence: Snapshot data_mode is synthetic_demo.

cases.statement: The delay leaves the delayed batch's harvest unsold in the near-term order across policies, while later orders stay met in most policies. Limits: these are synthetic scenario-minus-baseline deltas, not observed outcomes. Relevant metrics are fill rate and harvest weight.

assertions.evidence: Among affected later policy-lines, 6/7 Lean, 9/11 Balanced and 11/11 Resilient are fully met. The wording is ambiguous: not every later order remains met for Lean or Balanced.

assertions.text: The deltas are synthetic rather than observed.
assertions.evidence: The scenario is synthetic_demo.

assertions.text: Fill rate and harvest weight are relevant metrics.
assertions.evidence: Both metrics decline for every policy.

global_limits: This is an AI-assisted consistency review, not independent human expert validation.
The combined delay, yield reduction and allocator rerun do not identify a unique cause for aggregate outcomes.
Reference validation does not prove that arbitrary qualitative prose follows from selected references.
Synthetic results do not establish real agronomy, demand, market, logistics, costs, or farm safety.
No further paid request or capacity bypass was attempted.
